dog.description_text:
Bao is a 5-year-old mixed breed who weighs around 14 lbs, has enormous ears, and somehow manages to look like a cross between a piglet and a polar bear cub. His tail is almost always going, sometimes loudly enough to thump against his crate, and the rest of him tends to wiggle right along with it.

He’s sweet, easygoing, affectionate, and very cuddly, with a spunky personality that doesn’t tip into nonstop high energy. Bao is great on leash, interested in other dogs, and doing well with house-training. He does not enjoy being left alone, so he’ll do best with adopters who can help him feel secure and work on that with patience. We’re recommending an adult-only home for him.

Registered adopters interested in Bao can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
